newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Stocks quiet, Intel Corp halted.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Stocks quiet, Intel Corp halted.

text.p: Stocks were quiet in after-hours trading as the NASDAQ exchange halted trading on Intel Corp pending news of its quarterly earnings, traders said Tuesday.
The company announced late Tuesday fourth-quarter earnings of $2.13 a share against $0.98 a share for the same period the previous year.
"Great numbers," said Jonathan Joseph, an analyst at Montgomery Securities in an interview with the financial news television network, CNBC.
Although a published consensus among analysts called First Call predicted a $1.84 a share, most analysts were expecting for something more than $2.00, he said.
A NASDAQ official said it was not known when the exchange would release Intel's stock for trading again.
One trader later said Tencor Instruments climbed to 37 from a close of 30-1/2 before NASDAQ halted trading on the stock.
The New York Stock Exchange said session one had a volume of 302,100 shares against 311,500 on Monday. There was no session two.
